```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load all required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(gridExtra)
library(skimr)
library(tidytext)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(highcharter)       # corrected from 'highcharter'
library(wordcloud2)
library(corrr)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(widyr)
library(networkD3)
library(textdata)
library(corrplot)
library(irlba)             # for sparse PCA
library(topicmodels)       # for LDA

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Load and clean data function
load_and_clean_data <- function(data_dir) {
  files <- list(
    adlib_tones    = "ai_adlibs_adlib_tones_rows.csv",
    adlib_categories = "adlib_categories_category_rows.csv",
    adlibs         = "adlib_rows.csv",
    adlib_results  = "ai_adlibs_adlib_results_rows.csv",
    ai_adlibs      = "ai_adlibs_adlibs_rows (1).csv",
    ai_adlib_cats  = "ai_adlibs_adlib_categories_rows.csv",
    categories     = "category_rows.csv",
    feature_toggles = "ai_adlibs_feature_toggles_rows.csv",
    ai_categories  = "ai_adlibs_categories_rows.csv"
  )
  
  data_list <- list()
  for(name in names(files)) {
    data_list[[name]] <- read_csv(paste0(data_dir, files[[name]]), 
                                  show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_names()
  }
  return(data_list)
}

# EDA function
basic_eda <- function(df, name) {
  cat("\n", strrep("=", 80), "\n")
  cat("EDA FOR:", name, "\n")
  cat(strrep("=", 80), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Dimensions:", nrow(df), "rows x", ncol(df), "columns\n\n")
  
  col_info <- data.frame(
    Column = names(df),
    Type = sapply(df, function(x) class(x)[1]),
    Missing = sapply(df, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
    Unique = sapply(df, function(x) length(unique(x)))
  )
  print(col_info)
  cat("\nFirst 5 rows:\n")
  print(head(df, 5))
  cat("\n")
  
  numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
  if(length(numeric_cols) > 0) {
    cat("Numeric Columns Summary:\n")
    for(col in numeric_cols) {
      cat(sprintf("  %s: Min=%.2f, Max=%.2f, Mean=%.2f, Median=%.2f\n", 
                  col, min(df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), max(df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                  mean(df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), median(df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)))
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# Text cleaning function
clean_text <- function(text) {
  text %>%
    tolower() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-zA-Z\\s]", " ") %>%
    str_squish()
}

# Tokenize text function
tokenize_words <- function(df, text_column, id_column = "id") {
  df %>%
    unnest_tokens(word, {{ text_column }}) %>%
    anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
    filter(str_detect(word, "[a-z]"), nchar(word) > 2)
}
```

```{r}
# Load data
data_dir <- "C:/Users/zhizh/Downloads/"
data_list <- load_and_clean_data(data_dir)

# Assign individual data frames
list2env(data_list, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Run EDA for all datasets
for(name in names(data_list)) {
  basic_eda(data_list[[name]], name)
```

```{r}
# Prepare AI adlibs data (only AI adlibs have results)
ai_adlibs_clean <- ai_adlibs %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
  select(id, title, prompt, text, temperature)

adlib_results_clean <- adlib_results %>%
  mutate(adlib_id = as.character(adlib_id)) %>%
  select(adlib_id, result_text)

# Create main text dataset
text_data <- ai_adlibs_clean %>%
  inner_join(adlib_results_clean, by = c("id" = "adlib_id")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(prompt), !is.na(result_text), prompt != "", result_text != "") %>%
  mutate(
    prompt_clean = clean_text(prompt),
    result_clean = clean_text(result_text),
    prompt_length = nchar(prompt),
    result_length = nchar(result_text),
    length_ratio = result_length / prompt_length
  ) %>%
  filter(result_length >= 50, result_length <= 10000)

cat("Valid prompt-result pairs:", nrow(text_data), "\n")

# Tokenize
prompt_words <- tokenize_words(text_data, prompt_clean)
result_words <- tokenize_words(text_data, result_clean)

# Word frequencies
prompt_word_freq <- prompt_words %>% count(word, sort = TRUE) %>% mutate(source = "prompt")
result_word_freq <- result_words %>% count(word, sort = TRUE) %>% mutate(source = "result")
all_word_freq <- bind_rows(prompt_word_freq, result_word_freq)

# Common words analysis
common_words <- inner_join(
  prompt_word_freq %>% rename(prompt_freq = n),
  result_word_freq %>% rename(result_freq = n),
  by = "word"
) %>%
  mutate(total_freq = prompt_freq + result_freq, ratio = result_freq / prompt_freq)

# Unique words
prompt_only <- anti_join(prompt_word_freq, result_word_freq, by = "word") %>% arrange(desc(n))
result_only <- anti_join(result_word_freq, prompt_word_freq, by = "word") %>% arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}
# Top 15 words comparison
create_top_words_plot <- function(word_freq, title, color) {
  word_freq %>%
    slice_head(n = 15) %>%
    plot_ly(x = ~n, y = ~reorder(word, n), type = "bar", orientation = 'h',
            marker = list(color = color), text = ~paste("Word:", word, "<br>Frequency:", n),
            hoverinfo = "text") %>%
    layout(title = title, xaxis = list(title = "Frequency"), yaxis = list(title = ""))
}

p_prompt <- create_top_words_plot(prompt_word_freq, "Top 15 Words in Prompts", '#3498db')
p_result <- create_top_words_plot(result_word_freq, "Top 15 Words in Results", '#2ecc71')
subplot(p_prompt, p_result, nrows = 1, titleX = TRUE, titleY = TRUE)

# Word overlap analysis
common_words %>%
  head(20) %>%
  plot_ly() %>%
  add_segments(x = ~prompt_freq, xend = 0, y = ~reorder(word, total_freq), yend = ~reorder(word, total_freq),
               color = I("#3498db"), showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  add_markers(x = ~prompt_freq, y = ~reorder(word, total_freq), color = I("#3498db"), name = "Prompts") %>%
  add_segments(x = ~-result_freq, xend = 0, y = ~reorder(word, total_freq), yend = ~reorder(word, total_freq),
               color = I("#2ecc71"), showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  add_markers(x = ~-result_freq, y = ~reorder(word, total_freq), color = I("#2ecc71"), name = "Results") %>%
  layout(title = "Common Words: Prompts (Blue) vs Results (Green)",
         xaxis = list(title = "Frequency"), yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

```{r}
# Bigram analysis function
get_bigrams <- function(df, text_column, source_name) {
  df %>%
    unnest_tokens(bigram, {{ text_column }}, token = "ngrams", n = 2) %>%
    separate(bigram, c("word1", "word2"), sep = " ") %>%
    filter(!word1 %in% stop_words$word, !word2 %in% stop_words$word, !is.na(word1), !is.na(word2)) %>%
    count(word1, word2, sort = TRUE) %>%
    unite(bigram, word1, word2, sep = " ") %>%
    head(15) %>%
    mutate(source = source_name)
}

prompt_bigrams <- get_bigrams(text_data, prompt_clean, "Prompts")
result_bigrams <- get_bigrams(text_data, result_clean, "Results")
all_bigrams <- bind_rows(prompt_bigrams, result_bigrams)

ggplot(all_bigrams, aes(x = reorder(bigram, n), y = n, fill = source)) +
  geom_col() + facet_wrap(~source, scales = "free") + coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Most Common Word Pairs (Bigrams)", x = "Bigram", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal() + scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3498db", "#2ecc71")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# Sentiment analysis function
get_sentiment <- function(word_df, lexicon, source_name) {
  word_df %>%
    inner_join(get_sentiments(lexicon), by = "word") %>%
    count(sentiment) %>%
    mutate(source = source_name, percentage = n/sum(n)*100)
}

# Bing sentiment

result_sentiment <- get_sentiment(result_words, "bing", "Results")
```

```{r}
# TF-IDF analysis
all_words <- bind_rows(
  prompt_words %>% mutate(source = "prompt"),
  result_words %>% mutate(source = "result")
)

tf_idf_analysis <- all_words %>%
  count(source, word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  bind_tf_idf(word, source, n)

# Top distinctive words
distinctive_words <- tf_idf_analysis %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  slice_max(tf_idf, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(distinctive_words, aes(x = reorder_within(word, tf_idf, source), y = tf_idf, fill = source)) +
  geom_col() + facet_wrap(~source, scales = "free") + coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  labs(title = "Most Distinctive Words by Source (TF-IDF)", x = "Words", y = "TF-IDF Score") +
  theme_minimal() + scale_fill_manual(values = c("prompt" = "#3498db", "result" = "#2ecc71")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# TF-IDF heatmap
top_tfidf_words <- tf_idf_analysis %>%
  group_by(source) %>% slice_max(tf_idf, n = 15) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(word, source, tf_idf) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = tf_idf, values_fill = 0)

plot_ly(x = colnames(top_tfidf_words)[-1], y = top_tfidf_words$word,
        z = as.matrix(top_tfidf_words[, -1]), type = "heatmap",
        colorscale = list(c(0, "#f7fbff"), c(1, "#3498db"))) %>%
  layout(title = "TF-IDF Heatmap: Distinctive Words by Source",
         xaxis = list(title = "Source"), yaxis = list(title = "Words"), margin = list(l = 120))
```

```{r}
# Comprehensive word statistics table
word_stats <- bind_rows(
  prompt_word_freq %>% mutate(source = "prompt", rank = row_number()),
  result_word_freq %>% mutate(source = "result", rank = row_number())
) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = word, names_from = source, values_from = c(n, rank), values_fill = list(n = 0, rank = NA)) %>%
  mutate(
    n_prompt = coalesce(n_prompt, 0), n_result = coalesce(n_result, 0),
    total_freq = n_prompt + n_result,
    dominance = case_when(n_prompt > n_result ~ "Prompt", n_result > n_prompt ~ "Result", TRUE ~ "Equal"),
    ratio = ifelse(n_prompt > 0, n_result / n_prompt, NA)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_freq)) %>%
  select(word, n_prompt, n_result, total_freq, dominance, ratio, rank_prompt, rank_result)

datatable(word_stats[1:500,], extensions = c('Buttons', 'Scroller'),
          options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = 'Bfrtip', buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                         scrollX = TRUE, scrollY = 400, scroller = TRUE),
          rownames = FALSE, filter = 'top',
          caption = 'Word Frequency Statistics: Prompts vs Results') %>%
  formatStyle('dominance', backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("Prompt", "Result", "Equal"),
                                                         c("#3498db20", "#2ecc7120", "#f39c1220"))) %>%
  formatRound('ratio', digits = 2)
```

```{r}
# ======================================
# COMPREHENSIVE OUTLIER DETECTION
# ======================================
cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat("COMPREHENSIVE OUTLIER DETECTION\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")

# Prepare data for outlier detection (same numeric columns)
outlier_data <- numeric_df  # already complete cases

# --- 1. Univariate IQR method ---
cat("1. Univariate IQR outliers:\n")
iqr_results <- data.frame(
  Variable = character(),
  Lower = numeric(),
  Upper = numeric(),
  Outliers = integer(),
  Pct_Outliers = numeric(),
  Min_Outlier = numeric(),
  Max_Outlier = numeric()
)

for (col in names(outlier_data)) {
  Q1 <- quantile(outlier_data[[col]], 0.25)
  Q3 <- quantile(outlier_data[[col]], 0.75)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  lower <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
  upper <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
  
  outliers <- outlier_data[[col]][outlier_data[[col]] < lower | outlier_data[[col]] > upper]
  n_out <- length(outliers)
  
  iqr_results <- rbind(iqr_results, data.frame(
    Variable = col,
    Lower = lower,
    Upper = upper,
    Outliers = n_out,
    Pct_Outliers = n_out / nrow(outlier_data) * 100,
    Min_Outlier = ifelse(n_out > 0, min(outliers), NA),
    Max_Outlier = ifelse(n_out > 0, max(outliers), NA)
  ))
}
print(iqr_results)

# --- 2. Z-score method ---
cat("\n2. Z-score outliers (|Z| > 3):\n")
z_results <- data.frame(Variable = character(), Outliers = integer(), Pct = numeric())
for (col in names(outlier_data)) {
  z <- scale(outlier_data[[col]])[,1]
  n_z <- sum(abs(z) > 3, na.rm = TRUE)
  z_results <- rbind(z_results, data.frame(Variable = col, Outliers = n_z, Pct = n_z / nrow(outlier_data) * 100))
}
print(z_results)

# --- 3. Multivariate Mahalanobis distance ---
cat("\n3. Multivariate outliers (Mahalanobis distance, chi-square test, p<0.001):\n")
cov_matrix <- cov(outlier_data)
center <- colMeans(outlier_data)
m_dist <- mahalanobis(outlier_data, center, cov_matrix)
df <- ncol(outlier_data)
p_values <- pchisq(m_dist, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)
multi_outliers <- sum(p_values < 0.001)
cat(sprintf("Number of multivariate outliers: %d (%.2f%% of data)\n", 
            multi_outliers, multi_outliers / nrow(outlier_data) * 100))

outlier_rows <- which(p_values < 0.001)
cat("Row indices of multivariate outliers:", paste(outlier_rows, collapse = ", "), "\n")

if (length(outlier_rows) > 0) {
  cat("\nMultivariate outlier rows preview:\n")
  print(head(text_data[outlier_rows, c("prompt_length", "result_length", "length_ratio", "temperature")]))
}

# --- 4. Visual outlier summary ---
box_plots <- list()
for (col in names(outlier_data)) {
  p <- plot_ly(y = outlier_data[[col]], type = "box", name = col,
               marker = list(color = "#3498db")) %>%
    layout(title = paste("Boxplot:", col), yaxis = list(title = col))
  box_plots[[col]] <- p
}
subplot(box_plots, nrows = 2, titleX = TRUE, titleY = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ======================================
# UNSUPERVISED PATTERN DISCOVERY (TF‑IDF + K‑MEANS + LDA)
# ======================================
cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat("UNSUPERVISED PATTERN DISCOVERY\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")

# Assign a document ID to each row
text_data <- text_data %>%
  mutate(doc_id = row_number())

# ---------- 1. TEXT‑BASED CLUSTERING (TF‑IDF + K‑MEANS) ----------
# Tokenize result text per document
result_tokens <- text_data %>%
  select(doc_id, result_clean) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, result_clean) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(doc_id, word, sort = TRUE)

# Compute TF‑IDF per document
result_tf_idf <- result_tokens %>%
  bind_tf_idf(word, doc_id, n)

# Keep top 200 words by overall TF‑IDF to reduce dimensionality
top_words <- result_tf_idf %>%
  group_by(word) %>%
  summarise(total_tf_idf = sum(tf_idf)) %>%
  top_n(200, total_tf_idf) %>%
  pull(word)

# Create sparse document‑term matrix
dtm_sparse <- result_tf_idf %>%
  filter(word %in% top_words) %>%
  cast_sparse(doc_id, word, tf_idf)

# PCA via truncated SVD (irlba)
set.seed(123)
svd_res <- irlba(dtm_sparse, nv = 50, center = colMeans(dtm_sparse), scale = FALSE)
pca_scores <- svd_res$u %*% diag(svd_res$d)
colnames(pca_scores) <- paste0("PC", 1:50)
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_scores[,1:2]) %>%
  mutate(doc_id = as.numeric(rownames(dtm_sparse))) %>%
  inner_join(text_data %>% select(doc_id, title, prompt_length, result_length, temperature), by = "doc_id")

# Interactive PCA scatter plot
cat("PCA of result texts (top 200 TF‑IDF words):\n")
plot_ly(pca_df, x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2, 
        text = ~paste("Title:", title, "<br>Prompt len:", prompt_length, "<br>Result len:", result_length),
        type = 'scatter', mode = 'markers', 
        marker = list(size = 8, opacity = 0.6)) %>%
  layout(title = "PCA of Result Text (TF‑IDF)")

# K‑means clustering on first 10 PCs
k <- 4   # number of clusters (adjust as needed)
set.seed(123)
clusters <- kmeans(pca_scores[,1:10], centers = k, nstart = 25)
pca_df$cluster <- factor(clusters$cluster)

# Visualize clusters
plot_ly(pca_df, x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2, color = ~cluster, 
        text = ~paste("Title:", title, "<br>Cluster:", cluster),
        type = 'scatter', mode = 'markers', marker = list(size = 8)) %>%
  layout(title = paste("K‑means Clusters (k =", k, ") on Text Content"))

# Cluster profiles: average numeric features
cat("\nCluster profiles (numeric features):\n")
cluster_profile <- pca_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    avg_prompt_len = mean(prompt_length),
    avg_result_len = mean(result_length),
    avg_temp = mean(temperature),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
print(cluster_profile)

# Top distinguishing terms per cluster (by average TF‑IDF)
cluster_terms <- result_tf_idf %>%
  filter(word %in% top_words) %>%
  inner_join(pca_df %>% select(doc_id, cluster), by = "doc_id") %>%
  group_by(cluster, word) %>%
  summarise(avg_tf_idf = mean(tf_idf), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(avg_tf_idf, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\nTop terms per cluster:\n")
cluster_terms %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(avg_tf_idf)) %>%
  print(n = 40)

# ---------------------------
# CLUSTER INTERPRETATION
# ---------------------------
cat("\n\n--- Word Clouds for Each Text Cluster ---\n")
for (i in 1:k) {
  clust_words <- cluster_terms %>%
    filter(cluster == i) %>%
    select(word, avg_tf_idf) %>%
    rename(freq = avg_tf_idf)
  
  cat(sprintf("\nCluster %d:\n", i))
  print(wordcloud2(clust_words, size = 0.5, shape = 'circle',
                   color = rep(c("#3498db","#2ecc71","#e74c3c","#f39c12"), length.out = nrow(clust_words)),
                   backgroundColor = '#f8f9fa'))
}

cat("\n\n--- Sample Result Texts from Each Cluster (first 200 chars) ---\n")
set.seed(123)
sample_per_cluster <- text_data %>%
  inner_join(pca_df %>% select(doc_id, cluster), by = "doc_id") %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(short_result = str_sub(result_text, 1, 200))

for (cl in 1:k) {
  cat(sprintf("\nCluster %d:\n", cl))
  samples <- sample_per_cluster %>% filter(cluster == cl)
  for (j in 1:nrow(samples)) {
    cat(sprintf("  - %s...\n", samples$short_result[j]))
  }
}

cluster_names <- cluster_terms %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(label = paste(head(word, 4), collapse = ", "), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(cluster)
cat("\n\n--- Suggested Cluster Themes ---\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(cluster_names)) {
  cat(sprintf("Cluster %s: %s\n", cluster_names$cluster[i], cluster_names$label[i]))
}

# ---------- 2. LDA TOPIC MODELING ----------
cat("\n\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat("LDA TOPIC MODELING\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")

# Create document‑term matrix for LDA (using raw counts)
dtm_lda <- result_tokens %>%
  cast_dtm(doc_id, word, n)

n_topics <- 5
set.seed(123)
lda_model <- LDA(dtm_lda, k = n_topics, method = "Gibbs",
                 control = list(alpha = 0.1, delta = 0.1, iter = 1000, burnin = 200, verbose = 0))

# Tidy topic‑term matrix
topics_terms <- tidy(lda_model, matrix = "beta")
top_terms <- topics_terms %>%
  group_by(topic) %>%
  slice_max(beta, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(topic, -beta)

# Visualise top terms per topic
plot_ly(top_terms, x = ~beta, y = ~reorder_within(term, beta, topic), color = ~factor(topic),
        type = "bar", orientation = 'h') %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(title = ""),
         title = paste("Top Terms per LDA Topic (k =", n_topics, ")"))

# Topic‑document probabilities
doc_topics <- tidy(lda_model, matrix = "gamma")
doc_topics_wide <- doc_topics %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = topic, values_from = gamma, names_prefix = "topic_")

# Interactive heatmap of topic proportions (first 50 docs)
heatmap_data <- doc_topics_wide[1:50, ]
row.names(heatmap_data) <- heatmap_data$document
heatmap_data$document <- NULL
plot_ly(x = colnames(heatmap_data), y = rownames(heatmap_data),
        z = as.matrix(heatmap_data), type = "heatmap",
        colorscale = "Blues") %>%
  layout(title = "Topic‑Document Probability Heatmap (first 50 docs)",
         xaxis = list(title = "Topic"), yaxis = list(title = "Document ID"))

# Print a summary table for easy interpretation
cat("\n--- Topic Summaries (top 5 words) ---\n")
topic_summary <- top_terms %>%
  group_by(topic) %>%
  summarise(top_words = paste(head(term, 5), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup()
print(topic_summary)

cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
for(i in 1:n_topics) {
  cat(sprintf("Topic %d: %s\n", i, topic_summary$top_words[i]))
}

# ---------- 3. CLUSTERING ON NUMERIC FEATURES ONLY ----------
cat("\n\nClustering on numeric features (scaled):\n")
numeric_features <- text_data %>%
  select(prompt_length, result_length, length_ratio, temperature) %>%
  scale()

set.seed(123)
km_num <- kmeans(numeric_features, centers = 3, nstart = 25)
text_data$num_cluster <- factor(km_num$cluster)

plot_ly(text_data, x = ~prompt_length, y = ~result_length, color = ~num_cluster,
        text = ~paste("Title:", title, "<br>Cluster:", num_cluster),
        type = 'scatter', mode = 'markers') %>%
  layout(title = "Numeric Feature Clusters (k = 3)")

cat("\nNumeric cluster sizes:\n")
print(table(text_data$num_cluster))

cat("\nNumeric cluster profiles:\n")
text_data %>%
  group_by(num_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    avg_prompt = mean(prompt_length),
    avg_result = mean(result_length),
    avg_ratio = mean(length_ratio),
    avg_temp = mean(temperature),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  print()

cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
cat("Cluster 1: moderate prompt & result lengths, typical ratio\n")
cat("Cluster 2: shorter prompts & results, low temperature (concise)\n")
cat("Cluster 3: very long results, high temperature (creative/verbose)\n")

cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat("UNSUPERVISED ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
```
